analysis:
Both units are head-side text of docs/developer/test.md, a documentation-only change that adds test and CI guidance. I found no executable code, auth, crypto, billing or routing changes, so no concrete security regression qualifies.

The docs describe test fixtures and qualification gates for several areas covered by the threat model:
- The App Attest and build-qualification tests (TB-011, T-052..T-058) are described as not replacing signed-Mac qualification, which is consistent with the existing model.
- The SSD prefix-cache and encrypted-checkpoint tests (T-041) use random fixture keys and do not touch Keychain or production cache data. No TTL or HMAC change is described.
- The DiffusionGemma diagnostics keep raw captures private and say they are never production telemetry.
- Database-backed tests are explicitly warned to use a disposable DATABASE_URL.
- The release-publication and signing tests state that they use no credentials or live writes.

I saw no weakening of the threat-model assumptions. The scripts and workflows the docs reference (run-provider-tests.sh, ci.yml, the release workflows) were not supplied, so their actual behavior is not covered. Those would need review in their own diffs if they changed.
